episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Shuichi asks Kirie to escape this town together. Meanwhile, his father suddenly dies from being fixated on spirals, and then a mysterious spiral appears on the forehead of the class beauty Azami Kurotani. The real horror has just begun...

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Spiraling hair… an eerie spiral pattern emerging on the back of a classmate… a couple whose bodies intertwine… The spirals transformation is developing all over the town.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Kurouzu Hospital is in an uproar over the bizarre corpses drained of all blood. One night, Kirie wakes up to the echoing footsteps in the hallway. What she witnesses there is the unusual sight of pregnant women marching down the corridor.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The curse of the spirals is destroying the town and taking peoples' minds with it. The chaos reaches a fever pitch.
